customers_say: Customers find the water purifier easy to use with a user-friendly app and appreciate its impressive smart technology, including its LED light that gives it a modern look. They like the taste, noting it's free of metallic or chemical aftertaste, and find the installation process good. The reliability and value for money receive mixed reviews - while some say it functions well and is worth the money, others report it stops working after 9 days and warn not to buy it.

reviews.author: Sandesh Lewis
reviews.title: An excellent buy!
reviews.body: The best working and best looking water purifier. App is perfect too.. Water flow is top notch. Easy setup and fast refilling too. Very happy with the unit.

reviews.author: Gaurav Atravalkar
reviews.title: A perfect water purifier
reviews.body: I would simply say this is a great and the best product...!!! The best part is the adjustment of taste and mode as per the tds of the input water. The trust of atomberg, quick installation support and post sales service makes this a awesome product. Lastly affordable service prices and no dedicated amc makes it value for money. I recommend this product for all the new buyers and those who are looking for upgrading the purifier.

reviews.author: BOLLA PAVAN REDDY
reviews.title: Sleek, Smart, and Super Fast Installation! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
reviews.body: I am absolutely loving the Atomberg water purifier.the design is incredibly sleek, smooth, and sexy—it gives a truly classic and rich look to the kitchen.The smart features are a game-changer. Being able to control it entirely through my phone and monitor the live health of the purifier on the mobile app is incredibly convenient. Most importantly, the water taste is excellent. A huge shoutout to their service team as well—within just 3 hours of delivery, the installation team arrived, set everything up perfectly, and took the time to clearly explain every single feature. Highly recommended
